name: save-boot-12b-dialog-world-open
description: #108 attempt 1 (acceptance candidate: dialogOpen 0 -> 1, dialogWaiting 0 while typing then 1). Load disc1-wm1-kalm (Circle every 30 frames until g_GameState 3), then with no input: wait until window 0's state reads 0 (closed_wait), then until it is open (1..14, open_wait), then until it is 6 = WSTATE_TXT_DONE, text shown and waiting for Circle (done_wait; frames spent open but not yet waiting). Checks it reads 6 (waiting) and that a rerun matches; reports pointerEnabled (0 = a plain message, 1 = a choice).

win0.description: g_WindowData[0] (0x80083274, config/symbols.main.us.txt; WindowData 0x30 bytes, include/game.h) .state at +0x2C (s16 as u16): 0 WSTATE_INIT (no window), 1 SHOW, 2 TXT (typing), 4 WAIT_ROW, 6 TXT_DONE (text shown, waits for Circle), 7 CLOSING, 9 INIT_NEXT, 13 PAUSE_TXT_UNTIL_OK, 14 WAIT_NEXT_WINDOW.
